metadata.label: final-pilot-v1-shard5
metadata.methodology: Paid portfolios, exact elapsed clock including service drain, no terminal settlement or future sale credit. Same funding includes capex, prepaid care and retained cash; route-purchases do not claim equal spent capex. Traffic pressures are real paid promotion policies, renewing during prep if affordable. Same fixed seed labels do not imply identical customer draws. Intervals are descriptive t29 intervals, not multiplicity-corrected superiority tests.
